**1. Breaking existing translations — real defect (silent regression for all non-English users)**

File: `src/Mod/ReverseEngineering/Gui/Command.cpp`, lines 68–610 (and multiple `.ui` files).

Every `QT_TR_NOOP("...")` string is changed (ellipsis `...` → `…`, title-casing, wording). Qt's translation system uses the source string as the lookup key. Changing the English source string silently invalidates every existing `.ts`/`.qm` translation for every affected entry. Until translators update all locales, users in non-English locales will see English fallback text for every renamed menu item, tooltip, and dialog string — potentially dozens of strings across all the languages the project supports.

If this is intentional, the translation files need to be regenerated (`lupdate`) and translators notified in the same PR. If not, this is a silent i18n regression.

---

That is the only item I would raise. Everything else in this diff is cosmetic string reformatting (ellipsis style, title-casing, wording) with no behavioral effect on a single-language build.
